model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect of various language families on different models, including XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The horizontal axis lists the language families, ordered as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indo-European, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic; the axis is labeled "family". The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and ranges from 0 to 30 with a linear scale, marked at intervals of 10. Each model is represented by a distinct color: blue for XLM-L2, green for mBERT-R2, light green for XLM-R2, pink for mBERT-B2, and red for XLM-B2. The bars for each model have error bars. For IE-Baltic, the approximate values are 2 for XLM-L2, 5 for mBERT-R2, 6 for XLM-R2, 7 for mBERT-B2, and 6 for XLM-B2; IE-Indo-European shows values of around 10 for XLM-L2, 5 for mBERT-R2, 20 for XLM-R2, 25 for mBERT-B2, and 20 for XLM-B2; IE-Slavic shows values of around 10 for XLM-L2, 5 for mBERT-R2, 5 for XLM-R2, 18 for mBERT-B2, and 10 for XLM-B2; Semitic shows values around 15 for XLM-L2, 2 for mBERT-R2, 2 for XLM-R2, 16 for mBERT-B2, and 22 for XLM-B2; the rest of the language families have relatively low effect values with error bars showing variability. The bars are not sorted in any specific order and none are visually emphasized.
